title: The affine-local function-field square is a pullback of the diagonal
statement: Let X be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], η its generic point [def-sc-generic-point], U a nonempty affine open, and x a point outside U whose local ring B = O_{X,x} [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is Noetherian of Krull dimension one [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Put A = Γ(X,U), K = k(X) [def-sc-function-field], and T = A ⊗_ℤ B. Let φ : T → K be the canonical map induced by the germ map A → K and the stalk-specialization map B → K. Let j_A : Spec A → X be the affine-open chart, j_B : Spec B → X the canonical local-scheme morphism, and c : Spec K → X the canonical generic-stalk morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let q : Spec T → X × X be the pair of the spectrum maps of the tensor inclusions followed by j_A and j_B. Then the square with top arrow c, left arrow Spec φ, right arrow the diagonal X → X × X, and bottom arrow q is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product]. No separatedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Varieties Lemma Tag 09NB, opening paragraph of its proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09NB

proof.text: The stalk B is a local domain and K is its fraction field by lem-sc-integral-scheme-stalks-in-function-field. By Mathlib ringKrullDim_eq_one_iff_of_isLocalRing_isDomain, B is not a field; choose a nonzero t in its maximal ideal. The same characterization says t is in the radical of (a) for every nonzero a. Thus a divides a power of t, and IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd gives IsLocalization.Away t K. By lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion (Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization), Spec K → Spec B is an open immersion.

Compute the inverse image of U pointwise. Mathlib Ring.krullDimLE_one_iff_of_noZeroDivisors and locality make every nonzero prime of B its maximal ideal. That point is excluded because Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint sends it to x. The zero prime is in the range of Spec K → Spec B by injectivity of B → K. Conversely the unique point of Spec K maps to the generic point of X, by Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk and Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint. This point belongs to U. The germ map to the affine chart commutes by IsAffineOpen.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk. IsOpenImmersion.isPullback now gives the pullback square Spec K → Spec A over Spec B → X. All equalities and the pullback criterion are written directly in Lean.

Use CommRingCat.coproductCoconeIsColimit for A and B over the integers, take BinaryCofan.IsColimit.op, and apply isLimitOfPreserves Scheme.Spec. The resulting binary fan has point Spec (A tensor_Z B) and projections the spectra of the tensor inclusions. The two composites of Spec phi with these projections are the germ map and the stalk map, by Spec.map_comp and Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul.

Construct the limiting cone to the diagonal square explicitly with PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk. For any cone s, its diagonal commutativity implies that the composites of s.snd with the two tensor projections and their maps to X both equal s.fst. Lift those two maps through the geometric pullback from step 2. The two required factorization equations follow from the geometric lift equations and product hom-extensionality. Uniqueness follows from geometric pullback hom-extensionality and the assumed factorization through Spec phi. This proves exactly the original IsPullback statement.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.isPullback_affine_local_functionField_diagonal
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) [Nonempty U]
    (x : X) (hx : x ∉ U)
    [IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1) :
    let A : Type u := Γ(X, U)
    let B : Type u := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let K : Type u := X.functionField
    let φ : TensorProduct ℤ A B →ₐ[ℤ] K :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
        (X.germToFunctionField U).hom.toIntAlgHom
        (algebraMap B K).toIntAlgHom
        (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
    IsPullback (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))
      (prod.lift (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X))
      (prod.lift
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom : A →+* TensorProduct ℤ A B)) ≫
          hU.fromSpec)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom : B →+* TensorProduct ℤ A B)) ≫
          X.fromSpecStalk x))
